newsitem.title: USA: Exide Corp unit to issue D-mark junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Exide Corp unit to issue D-mark junk bonds.

text.p: Exide Holdings Europe SA, a unit of Exide Corp, is planning a global offering of 150 million marks ($90 million) in high-yield bonds next week, market sources said.
Market players are saying the rare Deutschemark-denominated offering of unsecured debt is a sign of the increase in demand for high-yield paper from European investors.
Morgan Stanely & Co will be the lead-manager of the 144a Eurobond offering of seven-year notes.
Proceeds will be used to repay bank debt and for acquisitions. Exide is a manufacturer of starting, lighting and ignition batteries.
The European roadshow for the offering kicked off on Tuesday and will end on Friday. A roadshow in the U.S. will be held next Monday and Tuesday, sources said.
Exide's offering will follow what some market players said is the first Deutschemark-denominated junk bond deal -- a 157.5 million offering from Geberit International SA
The issue of 10-year global senior subordinated notes, rated B2/BB, is expected to price via Merrill Lynch & Co on Thursday. Price talk is 10 1/8 percent to 10 3/8 percent, sources said.
Geberit, a maker of sanitary plumbing systems, is a unit of Geberit Betelingungs AG which was recently the subject of a leveraged buyout.
